issues.description: The problem statement and solution expect construct_zero_state_prep_circuit to return a stim.Circuit, but the template function signature declares a return type of None. This mismatch can confuse students about the expected return value and will cause type-checking or usage errors when students follow the spec or the tests that expect a stim.Circuit.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template function signature to return a stim.Circuit (-> stim.Circuit) and ensure the function returns the constructed stim.Circuit. For example, update def construct_zero_state_prep_circuit(... ) -> stim.Circuit: and return the prepared circ at the end so it matches the problem statement and the solution.
